description: ,APPOINTMENT STRONGLY RECOMMENDED, 60 PLUS VEHICLES IN STORAGE!!  2022 GMC Sierra 1500 Limited 4WD Crew Cab 147" AT4 is a capable, off-road-oriented full-size pickup that blends rugged trail readiness with everyday comfort and utility. This configuration pairs a four-door Crew Cab with the 147-inch wheelbase and short bed (approximately 5.8 ft / 69.9 in), delivering solid rear-seat space (around 40 in headroom and 43 in legroom) while keeping overall length manageable for daily driving and parking. Four-wheel drive is standard, backed by a two-speed AutoTrac transfer case, locking rear differential, hill-descent control, and an off-road suspension package that includes a roughly 2-inch lift, Rancho monotube shocks, skid plates, and recovery hooks. Ground clearance reaches about 10.9,11 inches, and the truck rides on aggressive all-terrain (or mud-terrain on many Limited AT4s) tires. Powertrain options center on strong torque delivery. The Duramax 3.0L turbo-diesel I6 (standard on many AT4 Limiteds) produces 277 hp and 460 lb-ft, paired with a 10-speed automatic for efficient towing and highway manners (typically rated around 20,22 city / 23,26 hwy depending on exact setup). Maximum towing is generally in the 8,800,9,100 lb range (higher with packages and specific configs), with payload supporting serious work or weekend loads. A MultiPro multi-function tailgate, spray-on bedliner, and integrated trailer brake controller enhance versatility. Inside, the AT4 Limited emphasizes a premium-yet-rugged cabin: perforated leather seating (often Jet Black with Kalahari accents), heated and ventilated front seats, available heated rear seats, dual-zone climate control, and a heated steering wheel. An 8-inch (or upgraded) GMC Infotainment system with wireless Apple CarPlay/Android Auto, Bose audio options, and available advanced driver aids round out the experience.
